description: This file implements various tensor creation functions such as linspace, logspace, range, and arange within the ATen native namespace, specifically for CPU backend, including handling of various tensor inputs and scalar parameters.

methods.name: Tensor & linspace_out(const Scalar & start,const Scalar & end,int64_t steps,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Creates a tensor with linearly spaced values between start and end, supports various input tensor and scalar combinations, and populates the result tensor.

methods.name: Tensor & logspace_out(const Scalar & start,const Scalar & end,int64_t steps,double base,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Creates a tensor with logarithmically spaced values between start and end, supporting various tensor and scalar inputs, using a specified base.

methods.name: Tensor & range_out(const Scalar & start,const Scalar & end,const Scalar & step,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Fills the result tensor with evenly spaced values over a range defined by scalar start, end, and step.

methods.name: Tensor & arange_out(const Scalar & start,const Scalar & end,const Scalar & step,Tensor & result)
methods.description: Creates a tensor with evenly spaced values over a range with specified start, end, and step, similar to arange.
